title: Non-pressure ulcer depth and burn extent
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the ulcer, or for the burn extent (T31) when the note is about a burn (only that code).
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for wound care.

HPI
Pt is a 56 y/o female presenting for scheduled wound care of a chronic ulcer on the right heel. Pt reports the wound has been slow to heal but denies increased pain, fever, or drainage. No systemic symptoms reported.

Medication List
Acetaminophen 500mg BID PRN.

Exam
General: Pt in no acute distress. CTAB.
Skin: Chronic ulcer noted on the right heel. Wound bed shows fat layer exposed. No signs of infection or purulence. Surrounding skin intact.
Vitals: BP 122/78, HR 72, RR 16, Temp 98.6F, SpO2 98% on RA.

Assessment
1. Chronic ulcer of the right heel.

Plan
Wound care nurse and provider evaluated the site. Confirmed fat layer exposed. No evidence of deep tissue involvement. Continue current dressing regimen. F/u in 2 weeks for debridement and wound progress.

Electronically signed,
D. Kowalski, MD
10/14/2026
explanations: Non-pressure chronic ulcer of right heel and midfoot with fat layer exposed: L97.412 (HCC 383).

hccs.label: Chronic Ulcer of Skin/Except Pressure/Not Specified as Through to Bone or Muscle
